fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency's International Merchandise Trade Statistics Bulletin for April 2026, published June 2026, reports monthly trade (exports N$9.8 billion, imports N$14.2 billion) and says the figures are revised monthly as the data sources supply information; the text names no administrative source (customs declarations are not named), and the Dec 2025 bulletin is a second edition of the same series.
title: Namibia International Merchandise Trade Statistics Bulletin April 2026
